source_rule: English is the translation source. Arabic is the authority where the two diverge on a fact, and the ONLY source of name spellings. Arabic-only content is not imported. precedent = the approved ru / de / zh values of the same string: reference, never source.
scope_rule: A string is in the batch because a built page shows it, not because a dictionary lists it. tier "rendered" = on the /ur/ home page, attractions index, calibration detail page, or the Urdu block of 404.html. tier "detail-template" = not on the calibration detail page, but rendered by the same detail template on attraction pages of batches b1 / b2 (measured on a trace build that gave those ten pages a placeholder title). tier "other-language-pages" = in the language-suggestion bar that other languages' pages show a visitor whose browser asks for Urdu — it appears once /ur/ pages are listed (measured on a trace build with the three pages listed). Every other ui.ts key renders only on pages that have no /ur/ version yet and is listed under later_rounds.
stage_file_shape: stage files carry strings = { "<id>": "<Urdu>" } with exactly the ids of this pack's strings, in this order. See tools/README.md.
placeholder_rule: A placeholder listed for a string ({op}, {n}) is kept exactly once, untouched. det.openMaps keeps its trailing space + U+2197. Digits that stand in the English stay Latin digits.

header_budget.rule: Navigation labels are bound by measurement, not by taste (CLAUDE.md: the header is measured, never estimated). After any change to a navigation label, tools/measure-header-fit.mjs must pass; it requires no overlap, ONE row and a header height of exactly 68px.

For that threshold to stay valid the bar may need at most 1478px: brand 71.6 + nav + actions + 2 x 16 gap, i.e. nav (ten labels and nine 10px gaps) plus actions (search button, saved-places link with its counter, language button, gold button) of at most 1374.4px — today 1373.6px with the English labels in a Latin face at 13.5px. The Urdu labels will be set in the Nastaliq face, which is wider and taller: the widths below are the English ones and are a reference, not a prediction. If the Urdu labels need more, the thresholds of the [lang="ur"] block are re-measured and moved (an engineering step for the coordinator), or shorter labels are chosen — measured either way.

home.name.title.en: Al-Ahsa… where the sand hides its water

precedent.ru: Аль-Ахса… где песок прячет свою воду
precedent.de: Al-Ahsa – wo der Sand sein Wasser verbirgt

home.name.body.en: “Al-Ahsa” is the plural of “hisy” — the sweet water that runs and gathers beneath a thin layer of sand; brush it away and it springs up. So this land has always been: a generous oasis promising life where no one expects it. Walk beside its springs and channels, and you will understand how it earned its name.
home.name.body.ar: «الأحساء» جمعُ «حِسْي»: الماء العذب الذي يجري ويُختزَن تحت طبقةٍ رقيقةٍ من الرمل، تكشفه يدُك فلا يلبث أن يفور. هكذا كانت هذه الأرض دائماً — واحةٌ سخيّةٌ تَعِد بالحياة حيث لا يتوقّعها أحد. امشِ قرب عيونها وأفلاجها، وستفهم لماذا حملت اسمها.

precedent.ru: «Аль-Ахса» — множественное число от слова «хиси»: пресная вода, которая течет и скапливается под тонким слоем песка; разгребите его рукой — и вода забьет ключом. Такой эта земля была всегда: щедрый оазис, обещающий жизнь там, где ее никто не ждет. Пройдите вдоль ее источников и каналов — и вы поймете, откуда взялось это название. На этом сайте арабский артикль в названиях мест пишется «Эль-» (Эль-Хуфуф, Эль-Укайр), а название оазиса дано в форме ЮНЕСКО — «Аль-Ахса», хотя в русских справочниках его пишут и «Эль-Хаса».
precedent.de: „Al-Ahsa“ ist der Plural von „hisy“ – dem Süßwasser, das unter einer dünnen Sandschicht fließt und sich sammelt; streichen Sie den Sand beiseite, und es quillt hervor. So war dieses Land seit jeher: eine großzügige Oase, die Leben verspricht, wo es niemand erwartet. Gehen Sie an ihren Quellen und Kanälen entlang, dann verstehen Sie, woher der Name stammt.
precedent.zh: “哈萨”（Al-Ahsa）是“希斯”（hisy）的复数——指薄薄一层沙土之下汇聚流淌的甘甜泉水；轻轻拨开沙子，水便涌了上来。这片土地向来如此：总在人们意想不到的地方涌出泉水，长出一片慷慨的绿洲。沿着这里的泉眼与水渠走一走，您就会明白这个名字的由来。

precedent.ru: Крепости, дворцы и мечети, которым есть что рассказать о минувших веках.
precedent.de: Festungen, Paläste und Moscheen, die von Jahrhunderten erzählen.
precedent.zh: 城堡、宫殿与清真寺，诉说数百年的往事。

cat.nature.d.en: Mountains, caves and palm groves of endless green.
cat.nature.d.ar: جبالٌ وكهوفٌ وبساتين نخيلٍ لا ينتهي خضارها.

precedent.ru: Горы, пещеры и пальмовые рощи, где зелень не кончается.
precedent.de: Berge, Höhlen und Palmenhaine in endlosem Grün.
precedent.zh: 山峦、洞穴，还有一望无际的椰枣林。

cat.crafts.d.en: From harvesting dates to embroidering cloaks by local hands.
cat.crafts.d.ar: من قطف التمر إلى تطريز البشوت بأيدي أهلها.

precedent.ru: От сбора фиников до накидок, расшитых руками местных жителей.
precedent.de: Von der Dattelernte bis zu Umhängen, die Einheimische von Hand besticken.
precedent.zh: 从采摘椰枣到为比什特长袍刺绣，皆出自当地人之手。

cat.taste.d.en: A warm kitchen: Hasawi rice, harees, mufallaq and date bread.
cat.taste.d.ar: مطبخٌ دافئ: الأرز الأحسائي والهريس والمفلق وخبز التمر.

precedent.ru: Душевные блюда: рис Аль-Ахсы, хариса из пшеницы, муфаллак и финиковый хлеб.
precedent.de: Eine Küche voller Wärme: Hasawi-Reis, Harees, Mufallaq und Dattelbrot.
precedent.zh: 热气腾腾的家常美味：哈萨焖饭、哈里斯、穆法拉格和椰枣面包。

cat.market.d.en: Al-Qaisariyah, with the scent of perfume and the gleam of gold and copper.

precedent.ru: Рынок Эль-Кайсария: аромат духов, блеск золота и меди.
precedent.de: Der Qaisariyah-Souk – mit Parfümduft und dem Glanz von Gold und Kupfer.
precedent.zh: 凯撒利亚集市里，香水芬芳四溢，黄金与铜器熠熠生辉。

cat.events.d.en: Festivals reviving the heritage all year round.
cat.events.d.ar: مهرجاناتٌ تُحيي التراث على مدار العام.

precedent.ru: Фестивали, которые круглый год оживляют наследие.
precedent.de: Festivals, die das ganze Jahr über das Erbe lebendig halten.
precedent.zh: 节庆贯穿全年，让传统在今天焕发生机。

home.feat.lead.en: From a cave-riddled mountain to a port on the Gulf — four landmarks that capture the spirit of the place.
home.feat.lead.ar: من جبلٍ مأهولٍ بالكهوف إلى ميناءٍ على الخليج — أربعةُ معالمَ تختصر روح المكان.

precedent.ru: От горы, изрытой пещерами, до порта на берегу Залива — четыре достопримечательности, которые передают дух этих мест.
precedent.de: Von einem Berg voller Höhlen bis zu einem Hafen am Golf – vier Sehenswürdigkeiten, die den Geist dieses Ortes einfangen.
precedent.zh: 从遍布洞穴的山峦，到海湾之滨的古港——四个地标，勾勒出这片土地的模样。

home.route.lead.en: Two days are enough to feel the oasis — its heritage heart first, then its water and green. Take the route as it stands, or swap its stops as you please.
home.route.lead.ar: يومان يكفيان لتلمس روح الواحة — قلبها التراثي أوّلاً، ثم ماؤها وخضرتها. خذ المسار كما هو، أو بدّل محطّاته كما يحلو لك.

precedent.ru: Двух дней хватит, чтобы почувствовать оазис: сначала историческое сердце, потом вода и зелень. Пройдите маршрут как он есть или поменяйте остановки на свой вкус.
precedent.de: Zwei Tage genügen, um die Oase zu spüren: zuerst ihr historisches Herz, dann ihr Wasser und ihr Grün. Folgen Sie der Route, wie sie ist, oder tauschen Sie die Stationen nach Belieben.
precedent.zh: 两天，足以读懂这片绿洲：第一天走进遗产腹地，第二天看水与绿。可以照着走，也可以随意调换其中的站点。

home.route.s1.d.en: Begin at the fortress that gathers mosque, barracks and towers beneath one wall.
home.route.s1.d.ar: ابدأ من الحصن الذي يجمع المسجد والثكنات والأبراج تحت سورٍ واحد.

home.route.s3.d.en: Climb by day, and watch the sea of palms unfold below you.
home.route.s3.d.ar: اصعد في النهار، وشاهد بحر النخيل يمتدّ تحتك.

precedent.zh: 巷子里香水气息弥漫，铜器泛着光泽，比什特长袍上的刺绣出自当地人之手。

home.route.s4.d.en: Mud walls carrying one of the oldest stories in Islam.
home.route.s4.d.ar: جدرانٌ من طينٍ تحمل واحدةً من أقدم حكايات الإسلام.

precedent.ru: Глинобитные стены, хранящие одну из древнейших историй ислама.
precedent.de: Lehmmauern, die eine der ältesten Geschichten des Islams tragen.
precedent.zh: 泥土砌成的墙垣，承载着伊斯兰史上最古老的故事之一。

home.route.s5.d.ar: خضرةٌ وحمضياتٌ يفوح عطرها، وقطفُ الليمون الأحسائي في موسمه من منتصف يونيو إلى نهاية أغسطس.

home.route.s6.d.en: Close at an ancient port where desert sands meet the blue of the Gulf.

owner_questions.what: How the brand line is written on /ur/ pages — unanswered since ruling P2 and carried to this batch. It decides site.brand (page titles "… — brand", og:site_name, the footer copyright line), the Arabic line of the wordmark (today tagged lang="ar" and excluded from the Urdu letterform guard), and the brand name inside foot.independence and the home-page title.
owner_questions.state_today: site.brand is defined for ar and en only; zh, de and ru leave it undefined and render the Latin "Visit Al-Ahsa". The root CLAUDE.md fixes og:site_name as the Arabic brand on Arabic pages and the Latin one on Latin-script pages, and says nothing about a third script.
owner_questions.for_the_stages: site.brand is in the batch because it renders. Do not settle the question in the text: keep the provisional form the earlier lines chose (leave the key out, i.e. the Latin brand) or raise it; a brand inside an Urdu sentence (foot.independence) meets the site rule "no Latin-script name inside an Urdu sentence" and must be raised, not smoothed over.

owner_questions.what: Large-number scale (open item P10) bites on inline.home.fact.palms.n ("2.5M+") and on home.hero.lead ("more than 2.5 million date palms").
owner_questions.for_the_stages: Keep the digits exactly as the English writes them and raise the item; do not convert.

owner_questions.what: The nine template strings judged on the calibration page are candidates, not approved interface (open item P27). The recommendation carried with them: for the category label of nature a longer form if the header and card measurement allow it, otherwise the candidate; "area" has a second registered candidate.
owner_questions.for_the_stages: They go through the chain like any other string. Each carries its candidate pair under "candidate".

held_for_owner.rule: Rendered on the three pages, but the wording is the site owner's to decide (owner_questions.brand). Not in strings: stage files carry no value for it. zh, de and ru leave the key undefined.

english_in_scripts_by_precedent.renders: appended to any copied selection longer than 150 characters, on every non-Arabic page
english_in_scripts_by_precedent.note: The component knows two languages only (Arabic / everything else): zh, de and ru pages append the English line too. Carries the brand (owner_questions.brand).

later_rounds.rule: ui.ts keys and category labels that no built /ur/ page (and no round-1 attraction page) renders. They belong to the rounds that build their pages.
